title: Truthfulness: How to Raise a Child Who Does Not Lie
summary: A child often lies out of fear of punishment or in search of acceptance. Make truthfulness safe: do not punish for confessing, and praise truthfulness even if the reality is difficult. Truthfulness is built with safety, not with threats.
try_this: This week: when your child tells the truth in a difficult matter, praise their truthfulness first before addressing the mistake.
reflection_prompts: When does your child resort to lying?
Do they feel that truthfulness is safe with you?
